notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome, no block encountered; robots.txt has general 'Allow: /' with no Anthropic/Claude bot rule, so no access restriction applied. TREE: built from header mega-menu 'Furniture' branch (the only top-level menu besides Lighting/Fans/Room/Brands/Inspiration/Sale that contains textile- or storage-relevant nodes) plus each category page's own sub-category tile strip; confirmed h1/canonical matched requested cat_id on every page fetched. Furniture > Storage (cat_id=573) has 3 sub-tiles: Desktop Storage & Baskets (648), Storage Furniture (649), Wall-Mounted Storage (650). Furniture > Rugs (cat_id=651) is a leaf with no sub-tiles. QTY: site shows no explicit 'N products' total on these listing pages; qty obtained by exhaustive pagination count of unique product cards (page-by-page) per storage.md #36 method 3 / textile rules equivalent. Rugs (651): pages 1-7 = 30 each + page 8 = 22, no further Next link -> 232. Desktop Storage & Baskets (648): page 1 = 30 + page 2 = 29, no further Next link -> 59. EXCLUDED: Storage Furniture (cat_id=649, page title 'Media Cabinets, Dressers, Chests, Nightstands, Etageres & Bookcases') -- verified product list is sideboards, benches, etageres, bookcases, vitrines, dressers, i.e. Furniture-boundary items per storage.md Sec21/27, not genuine storage containers; belongs to the separate Furniture task, dropped from this array. Wall-Mounted Storage (cat_id=650, page title 'Wall Cabinets, Medicine Cabinets, Wall Shelves & Open Shelving') -- verified product list is mostly wall hooks, coat racks/hangers, mirrors, wall shelves, wall cabinets (only 2 of ~30 sampled items were genuine 'Storage System' units); primary products are Furniture/Wall-Decor-boundary accessories per storage.md Sec18/Sec27, not a genuine storage/organization category as a whole, dropped. Decorative Accents (cat_id=647, under Home Decor/Furniture>Home Decor, title 'Sculptures, Bottles, Carafes, Candle Holders & Home Accents') -- scattered basket/bin items found (Restore Basket, Reduce Paper Bin, Silkworm Basket) but the site's own hierarchy presents this as a Decorative Home Accessories category, not Storage, and the products are decorative accents rather than storage-purpose containers per storage.md Sec5/Sec23-24; excluded. Seating (487), Tables (488), Outdoor Furniture (652), Office Furniture (656), Hardware (661), Home Decor (491) sub-tiles (Wall Decor/Planters & Vases/Clocks & Watches) were checked and contain no separate textile/storage nav nodes. Lightology is primarily a lighting retailer but does carry a genuine small Furniture/Home-Decor department (unlike SR175 Beacon Lighting's true 0/0); within that department it has exactly one qualifying Textile node (Rugs) and one qualifying Storage node (Desktop Storage & Baskets).
